title: epan: convert equal/compare functions to return C99 int
description:
used by wmem_map functions ex wmem_map_new_autoreset

Ping #19116

notes.body:
added 1 commit
  • 8f9854ac - epan: convert equal/compare functions to return C99 int
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/16302/diffs?diff_id=1056747138&start_sha=d66c3fd7675422ece0cf2ceee043fd9defe1197b)

`wmem_map_new()` is defined as taking `GHashFunc` and `GEqualFunc` function pointers. So long as we're doing that, I believe we should use the GLib types. Doing that makes them a drop in replacement for the GLib hash table functions. I can understand changing that, but I don't think it should be changed to `int` and relying on the implicit conversion between an `int` and a `gboolean`.
Make sense. Leave them as is then
